name: Anti-Magic Shell

activation.condition: which you take when you are the target of a spell

description:
You surround yourself with a field of necrotic energy that repels harmful magic. For the duration of the spell, you have advantage on saving throws against spells, and resistance to the damage from spells. Furthermore, when a spell allows you to make a saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the shell lasts for an additional two rounds for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Feral Spirits
material: A tuff of frostwolf fur and a gemmed totem worth 200 GP
description:
You call upon your shamestic ancestors form the twisting nether, taking the form of two ghostly wolves. They both manifest in an unoccopied space that you can see within range. These ghostly wolves use the @UUID[Compendium.wc5e-foundryvtt.summons.Actor.QdkdNFfDtc71gmSA]{Feral Spirit statblock}. The wolf will disappear when they reach 0 hit points, or when the spell ends.

The creatures are allies to you and your companions. In combat, both wolves share your initative count, but take their turns immediantly after yours. They obey of your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you do not issue a command, they will take the Dodge action and use it's movement to avoid danger.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, use the higher level wherever the spell's level appears within the statblock.
